cases.sentence: ___ (всегда успешная как показывает история) прямо противуположна этому правилу.
cases.explain: «Партизанская война» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: Guerrilla war (always successful, as history shows) directly infringes that rule.

cases.sentence: Противоречие это происходит от того, что ___ принимает силу войск тождественною с их числительностию.
cases.explain: «военная наука» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: This contradiction arises from the fact that military science assumes the strength of an army to be identical with its numbers. Military science says that the more troops the greater the strength. Les gros bataillons ont toujours raison.115

cases.sentence: ___ говорит, что чем больше войска, тем больше силы. Les gros bataillons ont toujours raison.[968] Крупные боевые силы всегда одолевают.
cases.explain: «Военная наука» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: This contradiction arises from the fact that military science assumes the strength of an army to be identical with its numbers. Military science says that the more troops the greater the strength. Les gros bataillons ont toujours raison.115

cases.sentence: Военная наука говорит, что чем больше войска, тем больше силы. Les gros bataillons ont toujours raison.[968] Крупные ___ всегда одолевают.
cases.explain: «боевые силы» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: This contradiction arises from the fact that military science assumes the strength of an army to be identical with its numbers. Military science says that the more troops the greater the strength. Les gros bataillons ont toujours raison.115

cases.sentence: В ___ сила войск есть также произведение из массы на что-то другое, на какое-то неизвестное х.
cases.explain: «военном деле» — after the preposition «в», for location or topic.
cases.translation: In military affairs the strength of an army is the product of its mass and some unknown x.

cases.sentence: Но подстановление всех этих значений множителя не доставляет результатов, согласных с ___.
cases.explain: «историческими фактами» — after the preposition «с», the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: Military science, seeing in history innumerable instances of the fact that the size of any army does not coincide with its strength and that small detachments defeat larger ones, obscurely admits the existence of this unknown factor and tries to discover it—now in a geometric formation, now in the equipment employed, now, and most usually, in the genius of the commanders. But the assignment of these various meanings to the factor does not yield results which accord with the historic facts.

cases.sentence: А между тем стоит только отрешиться от установившегося, в угоду героям, ___ на действительность распоряжений высших властей во время войны и мы отыщем этот неизвестный х.
cases.explain: «ложного взгляда» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: Yet it is only necessary to abandon the false view (adopted to gratify the “heroes”) of the efficacy of the directions issued in wartime by commanders, in order to find this unknown quantity.

cases.sentence: Определить и выразить значение духа войска, этого ___, есть задача науки.
cases.explain: «неизвестного множителя» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: The spirit of an army is the factor which multiplied by the mass gives the resulting force. To define and express the significance of this unknown factor—the spirit of an army—is a problem for science.

cases.sentence: Тогда только, выражая уравнениями известные исторические факты, можно из сравнения ___ этого неизвестного, надеяться на определение самого неизвестного.
cases.explain: «относительного значения» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: This problem is only solvable if we cease arbitrarily to substitute for the unknown x itself the conditions under which that force becomes apparent—such as the commands of the general, the equipment employed, and so on—mistaking these for the real significance of the factor, and if we recognize this unknown quantity in its entirety as being the greater or lesser desire to fight and to face danger. Only then, expressing known historic facts by equations and comparing the relative significance of this factor, can we hope to define the unknown.

cases.sentence: ___ о том, что надо действовать массами при наступлении и разрозненно при отступлении, бессознательно подтверждает только ту истину, что сила войска зависит от его духа.
cases.explain: «Тактическое правило» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: The tactical rule that an army should act in masses when attacking, and in smaller groups in retreat, unconsciously confirms the truth that the strength of an army depends on its spirit. To lead men forward under fire more discipline (obtainable only by movement in masses) is needed than is needed to resist attacks. But this rule which leaves out of account the spirit of the army continually proves incorrect and is in particularly striking contrast to the facts when some strong rise or fall in the spirit of the troops occurs, as in all national wars.
